content: Level Five, the verifying Sufis and those with experiential knowledge (ahl-i shuhūd), take as premise that the principle of existence descends through the divine levels and the engendered realms to manifest its full perfection in two ways. The first is manifestation (ẓuhūr), in which everything appears in completeness in the human being, a reality encompassing all universals and particulars.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
